key_insight: Skill Adapter personalizes reusable agent skills and routes them online as tasks, inputs, and environments change.
engineering_relevance: The approach can help tool-using LLM agents adapt shared procedures to user requirements while managing growing skill libraries.
method: Store local adjustments from user requirements and execution feedback as Adapters linked to general-purpose skills.
Route skills and Adapters into a task-level library, preload candidates, and recheck applicability when inputs become available.
Use reinforcement learning to optimize modification and routing decisions.
evidence_signal: Across ALFWorld, WebShop, and SkillsBench, Skill Adapter improves task success by an average of 11.43 percentage points over SkillRL, reduces mean execution time on all three benchmarks, and retains an advantage with 1,000 skills.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify Adapter maintenance overhead or establish generalization beyond the evaluated benchmarks.
paper_title: Skill Adapter: Personalized Modification and Online Routing of General-Purpose Skills
